actions.title: Have the watchdog hit the public tunnel hostname rather than only 127.0.0.1 and fold that into the heartbeat; tunnel.up today means a cloudflared process exists locally, so a connected-but-dead tunnel still reports up.
Add GET /presets and GET /queue to the route lists in docs/DESIGN.md section 6 and docs/ARCHITECTURE.md line 12; both routes are live and neither inventory names them.

Give the terminal-row prune its own lightweight scheduled pass or fold it into backlog-burndown-daily; 217 of the 426 live queue rows are completed and the only step that pruned them is ruled permanently disabled.
Give the 14-day and 30-day stale-pending triage a scheduled pass; six P1 and P2 items have sat 19 to 41 days with no escalation since the step that did it was disabled.
Cap the retained log DOM nodes and batch the scroll-height read; the console appends one node per streamed line forever and forces a reflow on every append.
REDACTED: a MED severity finding in the security lens is withheld from the public copy. See this project's own bar-raise report for detail.

Add an in-flight run counter and a wall-clock kill timer to POST /run, mirroring the 120-second timer the auth probe already uses; nothing today caps how many unbounded sessions can stack against the shared weekly window.
Write the auto-enqueued and enqueue-deferred lines into every bar-raise report; the 2026-08-20 report carries neither, so a silently failed enqueue would read exactly like the successful one it was.
Record the last verified-compatible claude version range in DESIGN.md and have check-readiness.ps1 warn when the installed version falls outside it; today it prints the version and asserts nothing.
Serve the model allowlist from the server the way projects.json and presets.json already are; it is hardcoded independently in server.mjs and public/index.html and the two can drift.
Reorder the nightly sweep so the pointer sync runs before verify.py; a clean run currently reports a false FAIL every night on the reports its own retention just pruned.
Clear the em dashes out of docs/DESIGN.md when it is next bumped; the file carries 49 of them while its own changelog preset instructs every future run to write without any.

Spend the next session on getting one real run through end to end rather than on another feature; the last two genuine attempts both failed before any work landed, one on the seven-day limit and one on authentication.

Re-pin the release and changelog presets to sonnet; four of the five presets run opus including mechanical work, and this project's own telemetry shows opus costing roughly three and a half times per token.
